description: Read a single sent email by id, to inspect its delivery, such as the SMTP response on a bounced send or the gate denial on a gate_denied one. Pass full: true for the stored record. Result: id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject, from_address, to_address, cc, bcc, reply_to, tags, in_reply_to_email_id, scheduled_at, canceled_at, error_code, error_message, gates, smtp_response_code, smtp_response_text, request_id, body_text, body_source, quoted_chars_removed, body_html, attachments and attachments_complete; a field that does not apply is null.

full.description: Return the stored record, with the HTML body and quoted history, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Sent email ID from listSentEmails or a /send-mail response.

name: getSentEmail

attachments.description: Files sent with it; read one with getEmailAttachment and source sent.

filename.description: File name; null when the email gave none.

part_index.description: Pass to getEmailAttachment to read it.

attachments_complete.description: False when some files sent may be missing from attachments.

body_html.description: The HTML body; null without full.

body_text.description: The body as text, quoted history left out unless full; null when there is none.

created_at.description: When it was sent or queued.

error_code.description: Why it was not delivered, as a code.

error_message.description: Why it was not delivered, in words.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

name.description: Rule that refused it, such as send_to_known_addresses.

reason.description: Why, as a code, when given.

in_reply_to_email_id.description: The inbound email it answers, for getEmail.

quoted_chars_removed.description: Characters of quoted history left out; 0 with full.

request_id.description: Id of the send request, for support.

scheduled_at.description: When a scheduled send goes out.

smtp_response_code.description: Remote server reply code, such as 550.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null when it is in none.

to.description: Recipients, as the To header shows them.

title: Get sent email
